issues.description: The problem statement and UML require calculateTotalPrice(Meal) to return a double (double precision financial calculation), but the provided solution implements calculateTotalPrice(Meal) returning an int. This mismatch can confuse students about the expected return type and precision and may cause tests or student implementations to diverge from the specification.
issues.suggestedFix: Align the implementation with the specification by changing the calculateTotalPrice signature and return type to double and compute the sum as a double. Update the solution (and any tests) so calculateTotalPrice(Meal) returns a double, or alternatively update the problem statement/UML to specify an int if integer pricing was intended. Preferably return double to match the stated precision requirement.
